summary: CLI bridges local PTY to hardcoded author-controlled WebSocket relay
details: The package's CLI (dist/cli.mjs) spawns a local shell via node-pty and bridges its stdio to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at wss://juny-api.kr/relay. Data received from the remote relay is written into the PTY as terminal input and PTY output is streamed back to the relay, giving whoever controls the relay endpoint interactive shell access on the host running the CLI. The relay destination is hardcoded to an author-controlled domain rather than a user-configured endpoint, and the pairing/authorization model for who is permitted to drive the PTY is opaque from the shipped code. Execution is gated behind explicit invocation of the CLI (not install-time or import-time), but once the CLI is running the remote party has full shell control over the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
